VI._name: SoundVib_MCM Examples.lvlib:Order Power Spectrum (Analog Tach, DAQmx).vi
VI.description: This VI demonstrates how to compute an order power spectrum with averaging. This VI uses DAQmx VIs to acquire sound or vibration signals and an analog tachometer signal and displays the order power spectrum continuously. \0A\0AINSTRUCTIONS\3A\0A1. On the DAQ Configurations page\2C specify the device and channel configurations\2C time settings\2C and tachometer channel information.\0A2. On the Order Power Spectrum page\2C specify the window type\2C block size or order resolution\2C and averaging parameters for power in band computation. \0A3. Run the VI.\0A\0AVIs USED IN THIS EXAMPLE\3A\0A1.\09OAT Analog Tacho Process.vi\0A2.\09OAT Convert to Even Angle Signal.vi\0A3.\09OAT Order Power Spectrum.vi\0A4.\09SVFA Power in Band.vi

FreeLabel.comment: Key Concepts\3A\0A\0AA. Using resampling to correlate the vibration signal with the rotational speed allows for this example to be used for online analysis.\0A\0AB. If vector averaging is selected\2C use a triggered signal. Vector averaging eliminates signal elements (noise and order components) that are not synchronous with the running speed.\0A\0AC. Since it may take multiple sets of data to produce a spectrum\2C the front panel indicators are only updated when a spectrum is complete. \0A

For more information on specific functions\3A Show Context Help <Ctrl+H>\0A\0ASteps\3A\0A1. Use the DAQmx AI Config XControl to configure DAQ channel properties and start the DAQmx task.\0A2. Specifies sample mode and reads input block size with the Timing Node.\0A3. Use the DAQmx Read VI to measure multiple samples from channels on the device.\0A4. Separates the tachometer waveform from the vibration waveform and gets specific waveform attributes.\0A5. Determines the tachometer pulse positions and generates a speed profile.\0A6. Resamples the vibration signal from an even-time-spaced signal to even-angle-spaced signal.\0A7. Determines the block size used to compute the order-power spectrum of the even-angle-spaced signal based on the order resolution setting.\0A8. Generates triggered even-angle signals for vector averaging in order power spectrum calculations.\0A9. Computes the order power spectrum of the input even-angle signal.\0A10. Computes the aggreate power of the specified spectrum range. \0A11. Call the DAQmx Clear Task VI to clear the Task.
